name: Marina and Dock Operations
audience: independent marinas, yacht clubs, and small dock operations
topic: transient arrival and dock maintenance handoffs for marinas

products.name: Transient Arrival Readiness
products.product: A focused marina transient arrival readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent marinas, yacht clubs, and small dock operations
products.problem: A transient reservation can be confirmed while vessel dimensions, slip assignment, utilities, access instructions, arrival window, balance, and dockhand coverage remain incomplete.
products.valueProposition: Turns marina transient arrival readiness into a visible operating queue so every transient arrival has a compatible assigned slip, current instructions, payment plan, and acknowledged dock handoff.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets marina transient reservation, boat slip arrival checklist, marina slip assignment, and transient boater workflow searches.

products.name: Dock Maintenance Handoff
products.product: A focused marina dock maintenance handoff workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent marinas, yacht clubs, and small dock operations
products.problem: Dock, pedestal, utility, access, and facility issues are reported by radio or whiteboard while affected slips, boater notices, contractor work, and verification remain separate.
products.valueProposition: Turns marina dock maintenance handoff into a visible operating queue so every marina maintenance issue has contained impact, assigned repair, affected-slip communication, and verified return to service.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets marina maintenance software, dock work order, marina service request, and dock maintenance tracker searches.
